source: Fiorillo and Tykoski 2014, PLoS ONE 9, Fig. 6: time-calibrated tyrannosaurid phylogeny with Nanuqsaurus (in red); vertical, root at the bottom, black range bars at the tips, Bremer values at nodes, dotted time lines with a stage column and Ma scales at both sides, a node symbol (open circle) for Tyrannosauridae and a stem symbol for Tyrannosaurinae. gold_note: Tyrannosaurid time tree, root at the bottom. Tyrannosauridae (node circle at the root) and Tyrannosaurinae (stem symbol on the branch below the tyrannosaurine node) kept as internal labels. 11 tips, fully resolved; 2 printed clade names kept as internal node labels.
